link.subject: {{sender}} at {{org}} sent you a document to {{verb}}
link.heading: {{title}}
link.body: {{sender}} at {{org}} asks you to {{verb}} this document. Open it with the button below. The link works until {{until}}.
link.safety: Before you {{verb}}, we email you a code. Nobody from {{org}} will ask you for this code.
link.footer: This link is for {{email}} only. If this was not meant for you, open it and choose "This is not for me".

resend.subject: Your new link from {{org}}
resend.body: Someone asked for a new link to "{{title}}". If it was not you, use this one and ignore that.

code.subject: Your code for {{org}}
code.heading: {{code}}
code.body: You are about to {{verb}} "{{title}}". Enter this code on the page to continue. It works for 10 minutes.
code.safety: Nobody from {{org}} will ask you for this code. Do not reply to this email.
code.footer: If you did not ask for a code, you can ignore this email.

copy.subject: Your copy from {{org}}
copy.body: Here is the record of what you did on "{{title}}": {{decision}} on {{at}}.
copy.footer: This copy goes only to the address the document was sent to.

staff.subject: Your turn to {{verb}} "{{title}}"
staff.body: Open Liaison, find "{{title}}" on your Home and choose Read and sign. This email has no link on purpose: you {{verb}} it in your own signed-in session.
staff.footer: No link for this is sent by email. When you choose Read and sign, a code to confirm it is sent to this address.

words.sign: By entering my name and the code, I sign "{{title}}" with a simple electronic signature.
words.accept: By entering my name and the code, I accept "{{title}}".
words.approve: By entering my name and the code, I approve "{{title}}".

home.codeLocked: The link for "{{title}}" sent to {{name}} is locked after too many wrong codes
home.sendFailed: The link for "{{title}}" did not reach {{name}}: send a new one

ask.sign: {{sender}} at {{org}} asks you to sign this document.
ask.accept: {{sender}} at {{org}} asks you to accept this document.
ask.approve: {{sender}} at {{org}} asks you to approve this document.

askOwn.sign: {{org}}: your turn to sign this document.
askOwn.accept: {{org}}: your turn to accept this document.
askOwn.approve: {{org}}: your turn to approve this document.

page.levelBody: you read the document, confirm with a code sent by email, and type your name. You get a copy and the proof.

read.heading: Read the document
read.body: Take your time. A short summary, which is not part of the document:
read.wait: Scroll to the end of the document to continue.
read.noPdf: There is no PDF file for this document.
read.question: A question first? Reply to {{sender}}'s mail. This link stays valid until {{date}}.

doc.failed: The document could not be loaded. Please try again in a few minutes.
doc.textLabel: Text taken from the file, to read more easily. What you sign is the pages.
doc.textEnd: To continue, scroll the pages to the end.
doc.empty: This document has nothing to read, so it cannot be signed or accepted here. Ask the sender for a new link.

identity.heading: Confirm who you are
identity.sent: We sent a 6-digit code to {{email}}. It shows this link reached the right person.
identity.resendAt: You can ask for a new code at {{time}}.
identity.name: Your full name
identity.capacity: Your role or capacity, as you sign
identity.wrongCode: That code is not right. Tries left with this code: {{left}}.
identity.codeEnded: This code has ended. Send a new code.
identity.sendFailed: We could not send the code. Please try again in a minute.
identity.noMailOnDemo: This is a demo: no code mail is sent here, so this step cannot be finished. Nothing was signed or decided.
identity.invalidText: Your name or role holds characters we cannot keep. Please type them again.
identity.nameNotDrawable: Your name holds characters the signature page cannot show. Please type it in Latin letters.
identity.notShown: Open the document first, then ask for a code.

sign.heading: Sign
sign.phraseHint: {{sender}} asked for these words. They are kept exactly as you type them.
sign.typeName: Type your full name to sign
sign.nameHint: Your typed name is your signature on this exact version of the document.
sign.onlyYou: Only you can sign this. Nobody, and no software, signs in your place.
sign.capacityNote: By signing you state your role yourself. Nobody checks it, so please be sure.
sign.recorded: This is a simple electronic signature. We record the time, your email, your name and role, your IP address and browser. They go into a proof of signature file you also receive.
sign.nameMismatch: Type your name exactly as you gave it in the step before.
sign.phraseMismatch: Type the words exactly as asked.
sign.proofEnded: Your confirmation has ended. Enter a new code to continue.
sign.versionChanged: The document changed since you opened this page. Nothing was signed.

accept.heading: Accept
accept.typeName: Type your full name to accept
accept.onlyYou: Only you can decide this. Nobody, and no software, decides in your place. This is a recorded acceptance, not a signature.
accept.recorded: We record the time, your email and name, your IP address and browser, and send you a copy.

approve.heading: Approve
approve.typeName: Type your full name to approve
approve.onlyYou: Only you can decide this. Nobody, and no software, decides in your place. This is a recorded approval, not a signature.
approve.recorded: We record the time, your email and name, your IP address and browser, and send you a copy.

decline.heading: Decline
decline.bodySign: Nothing will be signed. {{sender}} will be told you declined, and this link will close.
decline.bodyOther: Nothing changes. {{sender}} will be told you declined, and this link will close.

done.signCopy: When everyone has signed, the signed PDF and its proof of signature go to {{email}}. Keep that email: it is your own proof, separate from {{org}}'s systems.
done.otherCopy: A copy of what you decided goes to {{email}}.
done.told: {{sender}} has been told. This link is now closed.

declined.heading: You declined
declined.bodySign: Nothing was signed. {{sender}} has been told, and this link is now closed.
declined.bodyOther: Nothing changes. {{sender}} has been told, and this link is now closed.
declined.bodyOwn: Nothing was signed, and this turn is now closed.
declined.again: If you change your mind, or want to talk about it, reply to {{sender}}'s mail. A new link can be sent.

page.foot: No account needed. No trackers. Sent with Liaison, the software {{org}} uses.

expired.title: This link has ended
expired.why: It has passed its end date, so nothing can be signed here now. Nothing was signed with it.
expired.done: Asked. {{sender}} has your request and will send a new link to the address it went to.

used.title: This link has been used
used.why: A link like this works once. If that was not you, please tell us straight away.
used.action: Email my copy to the invited address
used.done: Sent to the address this link was for. Check your inbox.

revoked.title: {{org}} withdrew this link
revoked.why: The document may have changed, or may no longer be needed. Nothing was signed with it.

wrong.title: This link is for someone else
wrong.why: It was sent to {{email}}, and the code goes only there. If you are the right person, ask to be invited. Your request does not sign anything.
wrong.done: Asked. If {{org}} agrees, you will get a link of your own.

declined.title: You declined this
declined.why: Nothing was signed, and {{sender}} has been told. If you change your mind, a new link can be sent.
declined.done: Asked. {{sender}} will get back to you by mail.

signed.title: You have already signed
signed.why: There is nothing more to do here. The signed PDF and its proof of signature go to the invited address once everyone has signed.
signed.done: Sent again to the address that signed, if the copy is ready.

attempts.title: Too many wrong codes: wait 15 minutes
attempts.why: For safety, this link is paused for 15 minutes. You can try again at {{time}}. Nothing has changed, and the link stays valid.
attempts.done: Still paused. Please try again at {{time}}.

locked.title: Too many wrong codes: this link has stopped
locked.why: For safety, this link has stopped working. Nothing was signed with it. Only a new link from {{org}} can replace it.
locked.done: Asked. {{sender}} has your request and will send a new link to the address it went to.

replaced.title: A newer version replaced this one
replaced.why: {{org}} changed the document, so this link no longer works. Your new link went to the same address.
replaced.action: Send me the new link again

replacedNoLink.title: A newer version replaced this one
replacedNoLink.why: {{org}} changed the document, so this link no longer works. No new link has been sent yet: ask {{org}} for the new version.

ended.title: Access has ended
ended.why: {{org}} has ended this access, so this link no longer opens. Copies you already received stay yours.

notfound.title: This link does not open anything
notfound.why: Some of it may be missing. Open it again from the original mail, without changing it. If it still does not work, reply to that mail.
notfound.done: It still does not open. Please reply to the original mail.

down.title: This cannot open right now
down.why: It is on our side, not yours, and your link is still good. Nothing was lost. Please try again in a few minutes.
down.done: Still not ready. Please try again in a few minutes.

copy.waiting_for_others: Your copy waits for the other signers. When everyone has signed, the signed PDF and its proof of signature go to {{email}}.
copy.on_its_way: Everyone has signed. The signed PDF and its proof of signature are on their way to {{email}}. Keep that email: it is your own proof, separate from {{org}}'s systems.
copy.sent: The signed PDF and its proof of signature were sent to {{email}}. Keep that email: it is your own proof, separate from {{org}}'s systems.
copy.not_sent: Your copy could not be sent to {{email}}. {{org}} has been told.
copy.not_completed: You signed, but not everyone did: the document was declined or withdrawn, so nothing is agreed and there is no signed copy. {{org}} can send it again.
